parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return in a single request. Valid values: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: If the response is truncated, use the returned NextToken value in the next request to retrieve the remaining results.

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The rule type. Valid values:
- custom_condition: custom rule-based group transfer.
- associated_transfer: associated resource follow-along group transfer.
